candidates.name: Unbounded iteration
candidates.description: A loop over growing on-chain data can eventually exceed the transaction gas limit.
candidates.root_cause: The required work grows without a practical bound.
candidates.mitigation: Bound work per transaction or use a carefully designed batching approach.
candidates.severity_note: Illustrative test-data rating; actual severity depends on impact and context.

facts.text: A loop whose work depends on storage growth may become too expensive to execute.
Reaching the gas limit can stall a required contract operation.
A loop is not inherently a vulnerability; the relevant issue is whether required work can grow beyond feasible gas.
